_about: Every current by-name rule in integrations/vllm/{verity_vllm,verity_capture} (see tests/test_no_by_name_rules.py). class: S = structural by-name (answer recorded elsewhere), L = legitimate semantic knowledge, P = policy / serialization vocabulary. retires: the Draft 3.1 §12.3 phase that removes the rule. inventory: Appendix A row (ontology draft, 22 Sep). This list only shrinks: delete the entry when the rule is gone; never add one without a labelled decision.

phases.P2: Phase 2 — Q_module_body_v1 + the generic query interface replace members_for's by-name tables (Draft 3.1 §12.3)

phases.P4: Phase 4 — acquisition plan from required values + correspondence; occurrence resolution over correspondence records
phases.P4W: Phase 4 — input provenance by discovery (named_parameters ∪ named_buffers) with a basis per input (Draft 3 §5, §12.1.2)
phases.P5: Phase 5 — checks renamed and scope-bearing; the finalize board / commit_summary retired; admission on the live-allocation model
phases.P6: Phase 6 — delete per-model profiles and by-name tables after the findings harvest
phases.stays: stays — legitimate semantic knowledge or serialization/policy vocabulary (re-classify if a Definition annotation replaces it)
